content.text: The assignment provisions fully match our preferred position.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full. 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free right to assign to an Affiliate or to an M&A successor (notice only). 24.2 binds Vendor asymmetrically in our favour: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (reasonableness qualified), and never to a direct Customer competitor. 24.3 applies a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard to other assignments. 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control, and 13.3 lets us move licence rights in step with a permitted Section 24 assignment. No deemed-assignment trap or change-of-control exit exists elsewhere (the 9.2 insolvency right is mutual and carves out lawful reorganizations). No redline warranted.
